name: FARONEM ER Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About FARONEM ER TABLET

FARONEM ER TABLET contains Faropenem, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, and throat infections, urinary tract infections, skin and skin structure infections, and gynaecological infections.

FARONEM ER TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with rare hereditary problems like galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, and glucose galactose malabsorption. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARONEM ER TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney diseases, history of hypersensitivity or anaphylactic reactions to penicillin, cephem, or carbapenems, family history of atopy, poor oral intake or poor general health or vitamin K deficiency, diarrhea, and loose bowel movement. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARONEM ER TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARONEM ER TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

FARONEM ER TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARONEM ER TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking FARONEM ER TABLET are vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea and lack of appetite, gastritis, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, edema, muscle pain, and lethargy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Upper and lower respiratory tract infection
usesDetails:
Uses Of FARONEM ER TABLET

It is used to manage:

Upper and lower respiratory tract infection
Urinary tract infection
Skin and skin structure infection
Gynaecological infection
mechanismOfAction:
How FARONEM ER TABLET Works

FARONEM ER TABLET works against the bacteria by managing them from forming the bacterial protective covering (cell wall), which is needed for them to survive.
usageDetails:
How to use FARONEM ER TABLET

Take FARONEM ER TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Meromac 1gm Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION

MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.
uses: Pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia)
Gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION

Used to manage bacterial infections such as:

Pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia)
Urinary tract infections
Intra-abdominal infections
Gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease
Skin and skin structure infections
Meningitis
Septicaemia
mechanismOfAction:
How MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION Works

MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION is a broad-spectrum carbapenem antibiotic which is active against gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria. It exerts its action by penetrating bacterial cells readily and interfering with the synthesis of vital cell wall components, which leads to cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION

MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION will be administered intravenously only by a doctor or a nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.
sideEffects: Infections of the mouth or the vagina are caused by a fungus (thrush)
Frequent infections, high temperature, and sore throat
Sudden beginning of a severe rash or blistering or peeling skin (may be associated with a high fever and joint pains)
Severe allergic reaction (severe rash, itching, or hives on the skin, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or other parts of the body, shortness of breath, wheezing, or trouble breathing)

Serious skin reactions (serious hypersensitivity reactions involving fever, skin rash, changes in the blood tests, severe red scaly rash, skin bumps that contain pus, blisters or peeling of the skin, severe skin rashes appearing as reddish circular patches often with central blisters on the trunk, skin peeling, ulcers of mouth, throat, nose, genitals, and eyes)
Being breathlessness when you do not expect it and red or brown urine (may be a sign of damage to red blood cells)

Contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects after receiving MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION:

Severe allergic reaction (severe rash, itching, or hives on the skin, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or other parts of the body, shortness of breath, wheezing, or trouble breathing)
Serious skin reactions (serious hypersensitivity reactions involving fever, skin rash, changes in the blood tests, severe red scaly rash, skin bumps that contain pus, blisters or peeling of the skin, severe skin rashes appearing as reddish circular patches often with central blisters on the trunk, skin peeling, ulcers of mouth, throat, nose, genitals, and eyes)
Being breathlessness when you do not expect it and red or brown urine (may be a sign of damage to red blood cells)

warnings.details: MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION should not be used in pregnancy unless the benefit justifies the potential risk to the foetus. Consult your doctor before receiving.
MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION should not be used in breast-feeding women unless the benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving.
There is no data available, but it is anticipated that MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION will not affect the ability to drive and use machines.
MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION should be taken with caution in patients with kidney problems. If needed dose will be adjusted accordingly. Consult your doctor before receiving.
MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving.
Do not receive MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION if you are allergic to Meropenem, antibiotics such as penicillins, cephalosporins, or carbapenems or to any ingredients of this medicine.

MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION is not recommended to use in children below 3 months. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection for children above 3 months. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION.
MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your physician for advice before receiving MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION.

Others

MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION is not recommended if you have or had:

A history of gastro-intestinal problems like colitis
Hypersensitivity reactions

Before receiving MEROMAC 1GM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or had:

Severe diarrhoea

introduction:
Introduction About MEROTEC 1GM INJECTION

MEROTEC 1GM INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MEROTEC 1GM INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MEROTEC 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MEROTEC 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROTEC 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROTEC 1GM INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

name: FARONEM CV Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About FARONEM CV TABLET

Faronem CV Tablet is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as urinary tract infections, respiratory tract infections, ear, nose and throat infections, skin and soft tissue infections, gynecological infections, etc. It is usually prescribed when other conventional antibiotics are not working.

It contains a combination of faropenem and clavulanic acid which works by blocking the cell wall synthesis of bacteria, preventing their multiplication and exaceberation of infections. The clavulanic acid present in the medicine works by resisting the bacteria from releasing toxic chemicals that can inactivate the main active ingredient, faropenem.

Faronem CV is a prescription antibiotic that should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor. It is preferably taken after food to improve absorption and reduce stomach upset. Do not stop the medication before completing the full course, as it may lead to antibiotic resistance.

Before taking faronem CV, inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of faronem CV are diarrhea, loose bowel movements, abdominal discomfort, nausea, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FARONEM CV TABLET

Faronem CV is used in the management of following bacterial infections:

Urinary tract infections
Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Skin and skin structure infections
Intestinal and colon infections
Gynaecological infections
mechanismOfAction:
How FARONEM CV TABLET Works

Faronem CV Tablet is an antibiotic that helps manage bacterial infections by killing harmful bacteria in your body.

It contains Faropenem, which works by breaking the bacteria’s protective wall, stopping their growth, and eliminating the infection.
The second ingredient, Clavulanic Acid, makes the antibiotic stronger by preventing bacteria from becoming resistant to treatment.

This powerful combination ensures that Faronem CV fights infections effectively, whether it’s a sinus infection, pneumonia, urinary tract infection (UTI), skin infection, or stomach infection.

To get the best results, take the medicine exactly as prescribed, even if you start feeling better. Stopping too soon may allow the bacteria to return and make the infection harder to treat.
usageInstructions: Take Faronem CV 200mg Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow it whole with a glass of water.
Do not crush, chew, or break the tablet, as it may affect how the medicine works.
Do not stop taking Faronem CV without completing therapy duration, as it could make the bacteria more resistant to the medicine.
It is important to complete the full course of therapy to achieve better infection control
It is best to take Faronem CV after food to improve absorption and reduce the risk of stomach upset. Always follow your doctor’s instructions for the best results.
Take the prescribed dose at the same time daily to maintain steady levels in your body.
Do not skip or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.
If you experience any side effects, inform your doctor immediately.
The usual dose for adults is 200mg two or three times a day, depending on the severity of the infection. Your doctor will decide the exact dosage based on your condition.
The dosage for children depends on their age, weight, and infection severity. It is strictly determined by the doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness. Do not self-medicate in children.

For sinus infections and pneumonia, the typical adult dosage is 200mg three times a day for a specific duration recommended by your doctor. Completing the full course is essential for effective recovery.

For respiratory infections like bronchitis or lung infections, doctors may prescribe 200mg two or three times daily, depending on the infection’s severity. Always take the full prescribed course to prevent antibiotic resistance.
usageDetails:
How to use FARONEM CV TABLET

Faronem CV is a prescription medicine which should be used as directed by your doctor. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosages.

How to Take Faronem CV 200mg Tablet?
Take Faronem CV 200mg Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow it whole with a glass of water.
Do not crush, chew, or break the tablet, as it may affect how the medicine works.
Do not stop taking Faronem CV without completing therapy duration, as it could make the bacteria more resistant to the medicine.
It is important to complete the full course of therapy to achieve better infection control
Best Time to Take Faronem CV – Before or After Food?
It is best to take Faronem CV after food to improve absorption and reduce the risk of stomach upset. Always follow your doctor’s instructions for the best results.
Faronem CV Dosage Instructions:
Take the prescribed dose at the same time daily to maintain steady levels in your body.
Do not skip or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.
If you experience any side effects, inform your doctor immediately.

Faronem CV Dosage for Adults:

The usual dose for adults is 200mg two or three times a day, depending on the severity of the infection. Your doctor will decide the exact dosage based on your condition.

Faronem CV Dosage for Children:

The dosage for children depends on their age, weight, and infection severity. It is strictly determined by the doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness. Do not self-medicate in children.

Faronem CV Dosage for Sinusitis and Pneumonia:

For sinus infections and pneumonia, the typical adult dosage is 200mg three times a day for a specific duration recommended by your doctor. Completing the full course is essential for effective recovery.

Faronem CV Dosage for Respiratory Tract Infections:

For respiratory infections like bronchitis or lung infections, doctors may prescribe 200mg two or three times daily, depending on the infection’s severity. Always take the full prescribed course to prevent antibiotic resistance.

Faronem CV Dosage for UTI:

For urinary tract infections (UTI), the standard dosage is 200mg twice or thrice daily, as recommended by the doctor. Ensure adequate hydration while taking this antibiotic to support kidney function.

Faronem CV – Maximum Daily Dosage

The maximum recommended dose for adults is 600mg per day (200mg three times daily). Taking more than this without medical supervision may increase the risk of side effects and toxicity.
sideEffects: Antibiotic resistance – Bacteria may become resistant, making future infections harder to treat.
Gut microbiome imbalance – Long-term use may disrupt healthy gut bacteria, leading to diarrhea, bloating, or secondary infections like oral thrush.
Liver or kidney strain – Continuous use may put stress on these organs, especially in patients with existing conditions.
Severe allergic reactions (causing skin rashes, hives, difficulty in breathing, dizziness, ringing in the ears, generalized flushing, angioedema, perspiration, low blood pressure etc.)
Severe diarrhea, stomach upset and bloody stools with colon inflammation (colitis)
Severe allergic skin reactions which is accompanied by fever
Interstitial Pneumonia causing fever, cough, breathing problems, abnormalities in the chest x-ray
Low WBC count in blood test
Severe muscle pain, tenderness and weakness
Vitamin K deficiency which may cause increased bleeding
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of FARONEM CV TABLET

Like all medicines, faronem CV may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everybody gets them.

Common Side Effects of Faronem CV are:
Diarrhea
Abdominal pain
Loose bowel movements
Nausea
Rash
Mouth ulcers
Headache, Dizziness
Is Faronem CV Safe for Long-Term Use?

Faronem CV is generally prescribed for short-term use to manage bacterial infections. Prolonged or long-term use is not recommended unless specifically advised by a doctor. Extended use of this antibiotic may lead to:

Antibiotic resistance – Bacteria may become resistant, making future infections harder to treat.
Gut microbiome imbalance – Long-term use may disrupt healthy gut bacteria, leading to diarrhea, bloating, or secondary infections like oral thrush.
Liver or kidney strain – Continuous use may put stress on these organs, especially in patients with existing conditions.

If you require long-term antibiotic therapy, your doctor will monitor your health through regular check-ups. Always follow medical advice and never self-medicate for extended periods.

When to Seek Medical Attention?

Stop taking Faronem CV and inform your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Kidney problems causing painful urination
Severe allergic reactions (causing skin rashes, hives, difficulty in breathing, dizziness, ringing in the ears, generalized flushing, angioedema, perspiration, low blood pressure etc.)
Severe diarrhea, stomach upset and bloody stools with colon inflammation (colitis)
Severe allergic skin reactions which is accompanied by fever
Abnormal liver function test results
Interstitial Pneumonia causing fever, cough, breathing problems, abnormalities in the chest x-ray
Low WBC count in blood test
Severe muscle pain, tenderness and weakness
Vitamin K deficiency which may cause increased bleeding

warnings.details: Safety of faropenem was not established in pregnant women. Therefore, Faronem CV should be used in pregnant women only if the benefits overweigh the risks involved.
Clinical studies have shown that faropenem may pass through breast milk. Therefore, Faronem CV should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician.
No information available regarding the potential of faropenem affecting the alterness and concentration.

Faronem CV should be used with caution in patients with kidney problem. Careful dose adjustments and monitoring are required in such patients. Therefore, before taking faronem CV inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing kidney problems.
Do not take Faronem CV if you are allergic to faropenem, clavulanic acid, or other antibiotics.

Safety of faropenem have not been established in infants. Hence, your doctor will prescribe faronem CV to your child only if it is absolute necessary under careful medical supervision. Depending up on your child’s age, body weight and severity of infection, your doctor may alter the dosage of the medicine.

Faronem CV can be used in elderly patient under medical supervision. Close monitoring is required in elderly patients, especially if they have pre-existing kidney problems. FARORIGHT ER 300 TABLET contains Faropenem, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, and throat infections, urinary tract infections, skin and skin structure infections, and gynaecological infections.

FARORIGHT ER 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with rare hereditary problems like galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, and glucose galactose malabsorption. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARORIGHT ER 300 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney diseases, history of hypersensitivity or anaphylactic reactions to penicillin, cephem, or carbapenems, family history of atopy, poor oral intake or poor general health or vitamin K deficiency, diarrhea, and loose bowel movement. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARORIGHT ER 300 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARORIGHT ER 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

FARORIGHT ER 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARORIGHT ER 300 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking FARORIGHT ER 300 TABLET are vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea and lack of appetite, gastritis, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, edema, muscle pain, and lethargy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

FAROART 200 TABLET contains Faropenem, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, and throat infections, urinary tract infections, skin and skin structure infections, and gynaecological infections.

FAROART 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with rare hereditary problems like galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, and glucose galactose malabsorption. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROART 200 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney diseases, history of hypersensitivity or anaphylactic reactions to penicillin, cephem, or carbapenems, family history of atopy, poor oral intake or poor general health or vitamin K deficiency, diarrhea, and loose bowel movement. FAROART 200 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROART 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

FAROART 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROART 200 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking FAROART 200 TABLET are vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea and lack of appetite, gastritis, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, edema, muscle pain, and lethargy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Mero 1gm Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About MERO 1GM INJECTION

MERO 1GM INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MERO 1GM INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MERO 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MERO 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MERO 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MERO 1GM INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.
uses: Pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia)
Gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease

mechanismOfAction:
How MERO 1GM INJECTION Works

MERO 1GM INJECTION is a broad-spectrum carbapenem antibiotic which is active against gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria. It exerts its action by penetrating bacterial cells readily and interfering with the synthesis of vital cell wall components, which leads to cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use MERO 1GM INJECTION

MERO 1GM INJECTION will be administered intravenously only by a doctor or a nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.
sideEffects: Infections of the mouth or the vagina are caused by a fungus (thrush)
Frequent infections, high temperature, and sore throat
Sudden beginning of a severe rash or blistering or peeling skin (may be associated with a high fever and joint pains)
Severe allergic reaction (severe rash, itching, or hives on the skin, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or other parts of the body, shortness of breath, wheezing, or trouble breathing)

Serious skin reactions (serious hypersensitivity reactions involving fever, skin rash, changes in the blood tests, severe red scaly rash, skin bumps that contain pus, blisters or peeling of the skin, severe skin rashes appearing as reddish circular patches often with central blisters on the trunk, skin peeling, ulcers of mouth, throat, nose, genitals, and eyes)
Being breathlessness when you do not expect it and red or brown urine (may be a sign of damage to red blood cells)

Hypersensitivity reactions

introduction:
Introduction About FARORIGHT 200 TABLET

FARORIGHT 200 TABLET contains Faropenem, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, and throat infections, urinary tract infections, skin and skin structure infections, and gynaecological infections.

FARORIGHT 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with rare hereditary problems like galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, and glucose galactose malabsorption. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARORIGHT 200 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney diseases, history of hypersensitivity or anaphylactic reactions to penicillin, cephem, or carbapenems, family history of atopy, poor oral intake or poor general health or vitamin K deficiency, diarrhea, and loose bowel movement. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARORIGHT 200 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARORIGHT 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

FARORIGHT 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARORIGHT 200 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking FARORIGHT 200 TABLET are vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea and lack of appetite, gastritis, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, edema, muscle pain, and lethargy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MERO SB 1.5GM INJECTION

MERO SB 1.5GM INJECTION is a combination of Meropenem and Sulbactam which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage serious bacterial infections of the respiratory tract (Ex. pneumonia, cystic fibrosis), urinary tract (Ex. cystitis), stomach, genital tract (Ex. postpartum infections), skin and soft tissues (Ex. abscess, cuts, wounds), brain (Ex. meningitis) and blood (Ex. sepsis). It can also be used to reduce fever and chills that is suspected to be a bacterial infection in patients with a weak immune system.

MERO SB 1.5GM INJECTION should be used under careful medical supervision. It will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein. Make sure to receive therapy with MERO SB 1.5GM INJECTION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor. Stopping therapy or skipping doses in between therapy may not control infection effectively.

Before receiving MERO SB 1.5GM INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you previously experienced diarrhea after taking any antibiotics as a precaution.

Inform your doctor before receiving MERO SB 1.5GM INJECTION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving MERO SB 1.5GM INJECTION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, skin rash, pain or inflammation at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MERO SB 1.5GM INJECTION Works

MERO SB 1.5GM INJECTION contains two medicines namely meropenem and sulbactam. Meropenem is a powerful antibiotic. It kills the susceptible bacteria by interfering with the bacterial cell wall synthesis. It is effective against a wide range of bacteria (including both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria).

Sulbactam is a beta-lactamase inhibitor. It sustains the anti-bacterial activity of meropenem against the toxic bacterial proteins (such as beta lactamases). Collectively, these actions destroy the susceptible bacteria, manage their further growth and multiplication which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.

MERO SB 1.5GM INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MEROBAX 1GM INJECTION

MEROBAX 1GM INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MEROBAX 1GM INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MEROBAX 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MEROBAX 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROBAX 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROBAX 1GM INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

name: Meronem 500mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About MERONEM 500MG INJECTION

MERONEM 500MG INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MERONEM 500MG INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MERONEM 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MERONEM 500MG INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MERONEM 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MERONEM 500MG INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How MERONEM 500MG INJECTION Works

MERONEM 500MG INJECTION is a broad-spectrum carbapenem antibiotic which is active against gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria. It exerts its action by penetrating bacterial cells readily and interfering with the synthesis of vital cell wall components, which leads to cell death.

How to use MERONEM 500MG INJECTION

MERONEM 500MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously only by a doctor or a nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

name: Merosure 125mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About MEROSURE 125MG INJECTION

MEROSURE 125MG INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MEROSURE 125MG INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MEROSURE 125MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MEROSURE 125MG INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROSURE 125MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROSURE 125MG INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.
uses: Pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia)

mechanismOfAction:
How MEROSURE 125MG INJECTION Works

MEROSURE 125MG INJECTION is a broad-spectrum carbapenem antibiotic which is active against gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria. It exerts its action by penetrating bacterial cells readily and interfering with the synthesis of vital cell wall components, which leads to cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use MEROSURE 125MG INJECTION

MEROSURE 125MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously only by a doctor or a nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION

LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION is a combination of Cilastatin and Imipenem which belong to the group of medicines called Carbapenem Antibiotics. It is used to kill a wide range of bacterial infection in various parts of the body in adults and children. It is used in the management of complicated infections in the stomach, urinary tract, skin and soft tissue, lung infections (pneumonia) or infections during or post-delivery.

It may be used to manage patients with low white blood cell count having fever that may be caused due to a bacterial infection or in patients having bacterial infection of blood.

Before receiving LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have colitis or other gastrointestinal disease, kidney or urinary problems, any central nervous system disorders such as localized tremors or epileptic seizures and liver problems.

LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor. It is not recommended for use in children aged under 1 year and children with kidney problems.

The most common side effects associated with the use of LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, swelling and redness along a vein (extremely tender to touch) and rash. Inform your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens or persist for a long period of time.
uses: Complicated infections of the abdomen, urinary tract, skin and soft tissue infections
Suspected bacterial infection with low white blood cell count and fever
Bacterial infection of the blood associated with other infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION

Manages one or more following types of the infection:

Complicated infections of the abdomen, urinary tract, skin and soft tissue infections

Infections during or post-delivery
Suspected bacterial infection with low white blood cell count and fever
Bacterial infection of the blood associated with other infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION Works

LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION contains imipenem a beta-lactam antibiotic that works by inhibiting the penicillin-binding proteins thereby managing the bacterial cell from synthesizing the cell wall and ultimately leading to cell-death. Cilastatin present in LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION is a renal dehydropeptidase-1 inhibitor which is administered with imipenem to block its metabolism that would have otherwise caused necrosis of some parts of the kidney. Hence cilastatin and imipenem together helps to manage bacterial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION

LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous injection over a period of 20-60 minutes depending on the dose. Your doctor will decide the dose, duration and frequency of LUPINEM 500MG INJECTION therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MICROPENEM 1GM INJECTION

MICROPENEM 1GM INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MICROPENEM 1GM INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MICROPENEM 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MICROPENEM 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MICROPENEM 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MICROPENEM 1GM INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

introduction:
Introduction About MAHAFARO 200 TABLET

MAHAFARO 200 TABLET contains Faropenem, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, and throat infections, urinary tract infections, skin and skin structure infections, and gynaecological infections.

MAHAFARO 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with rare hereditary problems like galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, and glucose galactose malabsorption. Contact your doctor before taking.

MAHAFARO 200 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney diseases, history of hypersensitivity or anaphylactic reactions to penicillin, cephem, or carbapenems, family history of atopy, poor oral intake or poor general health or vitamin K deficiency, diarrhea, and loose bowel movement. Contact your doctor before taking.

MAHAFARO 200 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

MAHAFARO 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

MAHAFARO 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

MAHAFARO 200 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking MAHAFARO 200 TABLET are vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea and lack of appetite, gastritis, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, edema, muscle pain, and lethargy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Meronem 1gm Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About MERONEM 1GM INJECTION

MERONEM 1GM INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MERONEM 1GM INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MERONEM 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MERONEM 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MERONEM 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MERONEM 1GM INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

How MERONEM 1GM INJECTION Works

MERONEM 1GM INJECTION is a broad-spectrum carbapenem antibiotic which is active against gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria. It exerts its action by penetrating bacterial cells readily and interfering with the synthesis of vital cell wall components, which leads to cell death.

introduction:
Introduction About ZYFOR ER 300 TABLET

ZYFOR ER 300 TABLET contains Faropenem, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, and throat infections, urinary tract infections, skin and skin structure infections, and gynaecological infections.

ZYFOR ER 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with rare hereditary problems like galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, and glucose galactose malabsorption. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZYFOR ER 300 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney diseases, history of hypersensitivity or anaphylactic reactions to penicillin, cephem, or carbapenems, family history of atopy, poor oral intake or poor general health or vitamin K deficiency, diarrhea, and loose bowel movement. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZYFOR ER 300 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZYFOR ER 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

ZYFOR ER 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZYFOR ER 300 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ZYFOR ER 300 TABLET are vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea and lack of appetite, gastritis, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, edema, muscle pain, and lethargy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MERIT 1GM INJECTION

MERIT 1GM INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MERIT 1GM INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MERIT 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MERIT 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MERIT 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MERIT 1GM INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

introduction:
Introduction About MEROMAC PLUS INJECTION

MEROMAC PLUS INJECTION is a combination of Meropenem and Sulbactam which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage serious bacterial infections of the respiratory tract (Ex. pneumonia, cystic fibrosis), urinary tract (Ex. cystitis), stomach, genital tract (Ex. postpartum infections), skin and soft tissues (Ex. abscess, cuts, wounds), brain (Ex. meningitis) and blood (Ex. sepsis). It can also be used to reduce fever and chills that is suspected to be a bacterial infection in patients with a weak immune system.

MEROMAC PLUS INJECTION should be used under careful medical supervision. It will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein. Make sure to receive therapy with MEROMAC PLUS INJECTION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor. Stopping therapy or skipping doses in between therapy may not control infection effectively.

Before receiving MEROMAC PLUS INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you previously experienced diarrhea after taking any antibiotics as a precaution.

Inform your doctor before receiving MEROMAC PLUS INJECTION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving MEROMAC PLUS INJECTION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, skin rash, pain or inflammation at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEROMAC PLUS INJECTION Works

MEROMAC PLUS INJECTION contains two medicines namely meropenem and sulbactam. Meropenem is a powerful antibiotic. It kills the susceptible bacteria by interfering with the bacterial cell wall synthesis. It is effective against a wide range of bacteria (including both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria).

Sulbactam is a beta-lactamase inhibitor. It sustains the anti-bacterial activity of meropenem against the toxic bacterial proteins (such as beta lactamases). Collectively, these actions destroy the susceptible bacteria, manage their further growth and multiplication which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of infection.

name: Meromac 125mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About MEROMAC 125MG INJECTION

MEROMAC 125MG INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MEROMAC 125MG INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MEROMAC 125MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MEROMAC 125MG INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROMAC 125MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROMAC 125MG INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

name: FAROBACT 300 ER Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About FAROBACT 300 ER TABLET

FAROBACT 300 ER TABLET contains Faropenem, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, and throat infections, urinary tract infections, skin and skin structure infections, and gynaecological infections.

FAROBACT 300 ER TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with rare hereditary problems like galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, and glucose galactose malabsorption. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROBACT 300 ER TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney diseases, history of hypersensitivity or anaphylactic reactions to penicillin, cephem, or carbapenems, family history of atopy, poor oral intake or poor general health or vitamin K deficiency, diarrhea, and loose bowel movement. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROBACT 300 ER TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROBACT 300 ER TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

FAROBACT 300 ER TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROBACT 300 ER TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking FAROBACT 300 ER TABLET are vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea and lack of appetite, gastritis, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, edema, muscle pain, and lethargy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Merotrol 500mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About MEROTROL 500MG INJECTION

MEROTROL 500MG INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MEROTROL 500MG INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MEROTROL 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MEROTROL 500MG INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROTROL 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROTROL 500MG INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEROTROL 500MG INJECTION Works

MEROTROL 500MG INJECTION is a broad-spectrum carbapenem antibiotic which is active against gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria. It exerts its action by penetrating bacterial cells readily and interfering with the synthesis of vital cell wall components, which leads to cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use MEROTROL 500MG INJECTION

MEROTROL 500MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously only by a doctor or a nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MEROVAZ 1GM INJECTION

MEROVAZ 1GM INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MEROVAZ 1GM INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MEROVAZ 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MEROVAZ 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROVAZ 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROVAZ 1GM INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

name: FARONEM Dry Syrup 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About FARONEM DRY SYRUP

FARONEM DRY SYRUP contains Faropenem, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, gynaecological infections, and ear, nose, and throat infections. It can also be used to manage various skin and soft tissue infections.

FARONEM DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Faropenem. Consult your doctor before taking it.

FARONEM DRY SYRUP is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

FARONEM DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight, and disease condition. Contact your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of FARONEM DRY SYRUP are vomiting, stomach pain, constipation, diarrhea, and lack of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects bother you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FARONEM DRY SYRUP

It is used to manage:

Respiratory tract infections
Urinary tract infections
Gynaecological infections
Ear, nose, and throat infections
Skin and soft tissue infections
mechanismOfAction:
How FARONEM DRY SYRUP Works

FARONEM DRY SYRUP works against the bacteria by managing them from forming the bacterial protective covering (cell wall), which is needed for them to survive.
usageDetails:
How to use FARONEM DRY SYRUP

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. Reconstitute the medicine with the required amount of sterile water given along with the medicine. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

FAROSTEAD TABLET contains Faropenem, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, and throat infections, urinary tract infections, skin and skin structure infections, and gynaecological infections.

FAROSTEAD TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with rare hereditary problems like galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, and glucose galactose malabsorption. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROSTEAD TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney diseases, history of hypersensitivity or anaphylactic reactions to penicillin, cephem, or carbapenems, family history of atopy, poor oral intake or poor general health or vitamin K deficiency, diarrhea, and loose bowel movement. FAROSTEAD TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROSTEAD TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

FAROSTEAD TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROSTEAD TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking FAROSTEAD TABLET are vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea and lack of appetite, gastritis, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, edema, muscle pain, and lethargy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Merotec 2Gm Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About MEROTEC 2GM INJECTION

MEROTEC 2GM INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MEROTEC 2GM INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MEROTEC 2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MEROTEC 2GM INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROTEC 2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROTEC 2GM INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.
uses: Pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia)
Gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How MEROTEC 2GM INJECTION Works

MEROTEC 2GM INJECTION is a broad-spectrum carbapenem antibiotic which is active against gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria. It exerts its action by penetrating bacterial cells readily and interfering with the synthesis of vital cell wall components, which leads to cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use MEROTEC 2GM INJECTION

MEROTEC 2GM INJECTION will be administered intravenously only by a doctor or a nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.
sideEffects: Infections of the mouth or the vagina are caused by a fungus (thrush)
Frequent infections, high temperature, and sore throat
Sudden beginning of a severe rash or blistering or peeling skin (may be associated with a high fever and joint pains)
Severe allergic reaction (severe rash, itching, or hives on the skin, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or other parts of the body, shortness of breath, wheezing, or trouble breathing)

Serious skin reactions (serious hypersensitivity reactions involving fever, skin rash, changes in the blood tests, severe red scaly rash, skin bumps that contain pus, blisters or peeling of the skin, severe skin rashes appearing as reddish circular patches often with central blisters on the trunk, skin peeling, ulcers of mouth, throat, nose, genitals, and eyes)
Being breathlessness when you do not expect it and red or brown urine (may be a sign of damage to red blood cells)

Hypersensitivity reactions

Severe diarrhoea

introduction:
Introduction About DORIGLEN 500MG INJECTION

DORIGLEN 500MG INJECTION contains Doripenem which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in adults to manage serious bacterial infections of the respiratory tract (Ex. pneumonia), urinary tract (Ex. pyelonephritis), stomach and blood (Ex. sepsis).

DORIGLEN 500MG INJECTION should be used under careful medical supervision. It will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein. Make sure to receive therapy with DORIGLEN 500MG INJECTION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor. Stopping therapy or skipping doses in between therapy may not control infection effectively.

Before receiving DORIGLEN 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you previously experienced diarrhea after taking any antibiotics or have a previous history of stroke or fits as a precaution.

Inform your doctor before receiving DORIGLEN 500MG INJECTION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving DORIGLEN 500MG INJECTION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, skin rash and pain or inflammation at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

DORIGLEN 500MG INJECTION is a powerful antibiotic. It kills the susceptible bacteria by interfering with the bacterial cell wall synthesis. It is effective against a wide range of bacteria (including both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria). As a result, it destroys the susceptible bacteria, manages their further growth and multiplication and reduces the severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MEROCIL 1GM INJECTION

MEROCIL 1GM INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MEROCIL 1GM INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MEROCIL 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MEROCIL 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROCIL 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROCIL 1GM INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

introduction:
Introduction About MEROSAK 1GM INJECTION

MEROSAK 1GM INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MEROSAK 1GM INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MEROSAK 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MEROSAK 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROSAK 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROSAK 1GM INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

name: Meroza XP Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About MEROZA XP INJECTION

MEROZA XP INJECTION is a combination of Meropenem and Sulbactam which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage serious bacterial infections of the respiratory tract (Ex. pneumonia, cystic fibrosis), urinary tract (Ex. cystitis), stomach, genital tract (Ex. postpartum infections), skin and soft tissues (Ex. abscess, cuts, wounds), brain (Ex. meningitis) and blood (Ex. sepsis). It can also be used to reduce fever and chills that is suspected to be a bacterial infection in patients with a weak immune system.

MEROZA XP INJECTION should be used under careful medical supervision. It will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein. Make sure to receive therapy with MEROZA XP INJECTION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor. Stopping therapy or skipping doses in between therapy may not control infection effectively.

Before receiving MEROZA XP INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you previously experienced diarrhea after taking any antibiotics as a precaution.

Inform your doctor before receiving MEROZA XP INJECTION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving MEROZA XP INJECTION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, skin rash, pain or inflammation at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEROZA XP INJECTION Works

MEROZA XP INJECTION contains two medicines namely meropenem and sulbactam. Meropenem is a powerful antibiotic. It kills the susceptible bacteria by interfering with the bacterial cell wall synthesis. It is effective against a wide range of bacteria (including both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria).

Sulbactam is a beta-lactamase inhibitor. It sustains the anti-bacterial activity of meropenem against the toxic bacterial proteins (such as beta lactamases). Collectively, these actions destroy the susceptible bacteria, manage their further growth and multiplication which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.

MEROZA XP INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of infection.

MEROTEC 125MG INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROTEC 125MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROTEC 125MG INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

introduction:
Introduction About FAROZONE 200MG TABLET

FAROZONE 200MG TABLET contains Faropenem, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, and throat infections, urinary tract infections, skin and skin structure infections, and gynaecological infections.

FAROZONE 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with rare hereditary problems like galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, and glucose galactose malabsorption. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROZONE 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney diseases, history of hypersensitivity or anaphylactic reactions to penicillin, cephem, or carbapenems, family history of atopy, poor oral intake or poor general health or vitamin K deficiency, diarrhea, and loose bowel movement. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROZONE 200MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROZONE 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

FAROZONE 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

FAROZONE 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking FAROZONE 200MG TABLET are vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea and lack of appetite, gastritis, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, edema, muscle pain, and lethargy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Plugpen XP Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About PLUGPEN XP INJECTION

PLUGPEN XP INJECTION is a combination of Meropenem and Sulbactam which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage serious bacterial infections of the respiratory tract (Ex. pneumonia, cystic fibrosis), urinary tract (Ex. cystitis), stomach, genital tract (Ex. postpartum infections), skin and soft tissues (Ex. abscess, cuts, wounds), brain (Ex. meningitis) and blood (Ex. sepsis). It can also be used to reduce fever and chills that is suspected to be a bacterial infection in patients with a weak immune system.

PLUGPEN XP INJECTION should be used under careful medical supervision. It will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein. Make sure to receive therapy with PLUGPEN XP INJECTION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor. Stopping therapy or skipping doses in between therapy may not control infection effectively.

Before receiving PLUGPEN XP INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you previously experienced diarrhea after taking any antibiotics as a precaution.

Inform your doctor before receiving PLUGPEN XP INJECTION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving PLUGPEN XP INJECTION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, skin rash, pain or inflammation at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How PLUGPEN XP INJECTION Works

PLUGPEN XP INJECTION contains two medicines namely meropenem and sulbactam. Meropenem is a powerful antibiotic. It kills the susceptible bacteria by interfering with the bacterial cell wall synthesis. It is effective against a wide range of bacteria (including both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria).

Sulbactam is a beta-lactamase inhibitor. It sustains the anti-bacterial activity of meropenem against the toxic bacterial proteins (such as beta lactamases). Collectively, these actions destroy the susceptible bacteria, manage their further growth and multiplication which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use PLUGPEN XP INJECTION

PLUGPEN XP INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of infection.
